name: Thanh long Duc Hoa
summary: Dragon fruit from Đức Hòa, in the old Long An half, one of the province’s named farm goods.
origin: The old Long An half of Tây Ninh, joined to the province by Resolution 202/2025/QH15.
howToEat: Look for it with the other old Long An goods, such as Nàng Thơm Chợ Đào rice and rượu đế Gò Đen.
seoDescription: Thanh long Đức Hòa, dragon fruit from the old Long An half.
